label_source: CABBAGE / EMBL-EBI AMR Portal release 2026-07, scored through this repo's external_mic_labels.tier_for_isolate on operator-aware MIC (STRICT tiers only)
genotype_source: portal PRE-COMPUTED AMRFinderPlus, header-normalized via dna_decode.data.amr_portal.prepare

source_concentration_of_scored_set.reading: A cohort that fails this bar cannot reveal a determinant-family blind spot it does not contain -- the mechanism that made the gentamicin rmt gap structurally invisible. It does NOT make the metrics wrong; it bounds what they could ever have detected.

honest_limits: NOT CLONALITY-CORRECTED. These are isolate-level counts; Campylobacter surveillance collections are clonally structured, so read the metrics as isolate-level. The lineage layer (G8) is the open gate on this substrate and is NOT closed by this run.
The `database` column is an overlapping AGGREGATOR label, not a BioProject, so the source-concentration figures here are NOT this repo's per-BioProject diversity bar.
Campylobacter cipro resistance is overwhelmingly one well-catalogued determinant (gyrA_T86I), so a high score is MECHANISTICALLY EXPECTED and is not evidence of broad catalog coverage.

A fetch failure means the portal's genomes/ tree lacks that assembly; those isolates are EXCLUDED and counted, never scored as wrong. Tree coverage is uncensused (see constraint `cabbage-genomes-tree-coverage-uncensused`).
Leakage exclusion is accession-string based (version-insensitive). It does not resolve BioSample identity, so an isolate deposited under two different assemblies could survive.

GEOGRAPHICALLY CONCENTRATED: see source_concentration_of_scored_set.verdict. Do NOT quote this cell as source-diverse. What it DOES add is INDEPENDENCE: the provenance-disjoint Campylobacter cipro cell is PRJNA560409 (Univ. Melbourne, N=40) and the prospective cell is PRJNA563067 (PulseNet Canada, N=426, 100% one BioProject). Each fails the diversity bar alone; that they are three MUTUALLY INDEPENDENT national collections is the part worth keeping.
